greenfield_config._note: Sim 4 greenfield: an understanding-only transfer test of the infill-chosen sensors against imaginary edge estates; not a planning or capacity study. One representative per edge stretch, with at least min_homes of downstream property headroom on every route, including relief pipes.
greenfield_config._source: SA Water Sewerage Code Supplement Pt 1, cl 4.5.5 and Table 4.4 (Amdt Jun09): maximum allowable EP 1000/2500/4500 for DN150/225/300, equivalent properties 400/1000/1800.
greenfield_config._property_limits: SA Water Supplement Table 4.4 limits apply only to reticulation sewers, DN150-300. Above DN300 (branch and trunk sewers, DN375+), there is no property limit; capacity is left to SWMM. Below DN150 use 400 x (D/0.150)^(8/3), a team scaling assumption. Other unlisted reticulation diameters scale from the nearest table DN at equal slope and roughness; within 5 mm of a listed DN use that entry. D is in metres.
greenfield_config._assumptions: Estate sizes and the short edge connection are team assumptions. Every site's ceiling is the smaller of floored property headroom and the largest configured step; a path with no Table 4.4 cap uses that largest step. Retain every smaller configured step plus the ceiling.
greenfield_config._edge: Open sector beside the manhole, using all gravity pipes held by Network sampled every 10 m and existing homes/connections; its middle must have 60 m clearance towards open land. Cluster sites sharing a non-null limiting pipe or lying within cluster_radius_m with bearings within cluster_angle_deg; keep the largest sector, then lowest manhole id.
greenfield_config._estate_ii: Team assumption: add sewage only, exactly as Sim25Model greenfield growth does, with no extra infiltration for the estate's own new pipes. No public data gives estate pipe lengths or infiltration.
